name: A Grim Fate
summary: A patrol sighting on Fenris Isle raises concern for an elf and an Earthen Ring traveling party. You are asked to investigate the party’s fate.

sections.title: A Pyre on the Shore
sections.body: A patrolman saw gnolls place a large body on a pyre along Fenris Isle’s shore. He saw no elf or smaller bodies, and fears for the traveling party. You are asked to search the isle and learn what became of them.

sections.title: The Body
sections.body: On Fenris Isle, the body is Tauren, and it has been heavily gnawed. The elf woman is nowhere in sight. She may still be deeper in the nearby fortress, so her fate remains uncertain.

faq.answer: A patrolman saw gnolls placing a large body on a pyre on Fenris Isle’s shore.
The party is described as an Earthen Ring traveling party.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Fenris Isle?
faq.answer: You are asked to investigate Fenris Isle and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.

faq.q: Was the elf seen on the shore?
faq.answer: The patrolman saw no elf among those at the pyre.

angles.text: As a paladin, the patrolman appeals to your sense of oaths, though he doubts this search is worth the danger.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Grim Fate
